Product Features

  • Overall size: 200 x 40 x 40 cm, the warm white high-gloss look is a real eye-catcher and the high-gloss design of the top desk top and drawer top gives the TV cabinet an exquisite look and easily makes it the visual focal point of the living room.
  • 3 drawers: The 3 drawers are cleverly designed. The rebound switch opens with a single press. The bottom slide rail is smooth and noiseless, so you can take items out silently. It is very convenient to store small items and say goodbye to the clutter in the living room.
  • Unique shape: The unique shape, which is narrow in the middle and wide at the top and bottom, breaks the traditional monotony and gives the room a sense of design. The lines are clearly layered and match different furnishing styles such as modern simplicity and light luxury.
  • Material: The chipboard is sturdy and durable. Although a load of 40 kg is recommended, this is enough for the daily placement of TVs, set-top boxes, etc., and can withstand the daily usage demands in the living room.
  • Colour: Warm white is soft and versatile. Whether it is combined with light grey walls to create a sense of luxury or combined with the original wooden style to show warmth, it can perfectly match and enhance the overall atmosphere of the living room.
  • High Gloss and Easy to Clean: The high gloss finish is easy to clean, coffee stains and dust can be removed with a light wipe, and maintenance is very easy. Even on busy days, you can easily keep the living room clean and tidy.
  • Storage space: The combination of drawers + open shelves ensures flexible and varied storage space. The drawers can be used to hide small items, while the open area can be used to place books and decorative objects, combining display and storage functions.
  • Easy Assembly: No complicated installation is required, the sensible structural design is simple and easy to understand, and can be easily integrated into the living space design. It uses simple lines and practical functions to interpret the comfortable aesthetics of a modern home.
  • Practicality: From appearance to function, it reflects concern for life everywhere. The warm white high gloss is a sign of refinement and the drawer design conceals ingenuity, creating a practical and beautiful "storage and presentation world" for the living room.
  • NOTE: This product consists of two packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages have arrived before you start assembling!

Descriptions

Description

This 200 x 40 x 40 cm warm white high gloss TV cabinet features a unique design that is narrow in the middle and wide at the top and bottom, so it fits many different styles. The high-gloss design of the top and drawer top is exquisite, and the 3 drawers are equipped with rebound dampers and bottom guides that run quietly and smoothly. The drawers and open shelves offer flexible storage options. The chipboard is robust and can withstand the stresses of daily use. The warm white colour is versatile and easy to clean. It is easy to assemble. Viewed from the outside and in terms of function, it creates a practical and beautiful "storage and display space" for the living room.
